test_solution_fixed_point: test the MMDDilatedEnt class to verify a QRE solution is a fixed point of MMD
test_gap: test the MMDDilatedEnt.get_gap method to verify gap is zero for a QRE solution
test_rps_update: test the MMDDilatedEnt.update_sequences method on matrix_rps with various alpha values
create_MMDDilatedEnt: create an MMDDilatedEnt instance with a pyspiel game and alpha parameter for MMD algorithm
run_update_sequences: run MMDDilatedEnt.update_sequences to iterate the magnetic mirror descent algorithm
